Class StaticAdvice<T>

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.context.python.aop.StaticAdvice<T>
Type Parameters:
T - The bean type
@Internal public final class StaticAdvice<T> extends Object
The interceptor chains of the compiled methods of a Python bean's proxy. A compiled method of the generated class runs its body as Java; when the bean is advised, the proxy the context hands out binds this advice, and the method runs its interceptors in Java before the body, the way a proxy compiled for a Java bean does. The chain ends on the target bean, whose own generated class runs the body; the target binds no advice, so the body runs once. The abstract methods of an introduction run the introduction's interceptors alone, on the proxy itself.
Since:
5.3.0

    • result

      public static @Nullable Object result(@Nullable Object value, String returnType)
      Converts what an interceptor chain returned to the return type of the generated method, as the bridge converts the value of a Python call: a number to a primitive or its box only when it fits exactly, a str of one character to a char, None to no primitive.
      Parameters:
      value - What the chain returned
      returnType - The name of the return type of the generated method
      Returns:
      The value, of the return type when it is a primitive or its box
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - When the value is null and the return type is a primitive
      ClassCastException - When the value does not convert to the return type
